GOAL: pick one mechanism shape that the three measured failures do not already refute.
READ: the round-4 brief: R1 curved residual chain 0.05439; R2 global geodesic step to successor barycentre, 99.1% of items moved, 0.05165; R3 extra 4th SID level from PPMI successor direction, deepest partition 6235 level-4 prefixes, 0.04823; frozen baseline about 0.0679, gate 0.065. Also: behaviour-CONTRAST metrics predict recall (+0.7104 plain, +0.7170 Euclidean control) while Gromov-delta weighting (-0.12) and ancestor-depth weighting (-0.075) hurt; curvature is a gauge; origin-minimum objectives collapse the encoder; priors tried: poincare-frechet-successor-codebook, CURVCTRL-SID, BRad-RQ, BRANCHCURV-MOEB-RQ, TSG-SID (all probes NOT_RUN).
OBSERVED: every previous mechanism moved the many, and loss grew with distance from the plain text geometry, not with prefix count. So the only untested region is shape (A): leave ~95% of the partition bit-identical and repair only the null-significant tail, at quantization, with a measured guard.
REASONING: choose a sparse post-Stage2 curved re-quantization audit: train-only successor-PPMI contrast sets eligibility via a permutation null; Lorentz/hyperboloid subtree-Voronoi score chooses the codeword; a prefix guard caps and reports drift. Geometry is gauge-fixed by a data quantile, so no curvature tuning; equal z-score weights mean no coupling weight to sweep.
OPEN: exact equations, null calibration, guard bisection, cost, and the three ablation switches.

ANSWER HCAUDIT-SID part 1/3:
IDEA: HCAUDIT-SID
TITLE: Null-calibrated hyperbolic contrast audit that repairs at most five percent of SID assignments inside a measured prefix guard
MOTIVATION: SHAPE (A). Three rounds moved the many (curved residual 0.05439; global geodesic pull of 99.1% of items 0.05165; global extra PPMI level 0.04823) and lost monotonically with distance from the plain text geometry, not with prefix count. Behaviour CONTRAST is the only diagnostic that predicts recall (+0.7104 plain, +0.7170 Euclidean control) while Gromov-delta weighting and ancestor-depth weighting hurt (+0.12, +0.075 wrongly signed). So this mechanism freezes the encoder, adds no level, pulls nothing to a barycentre, uses no Gromov delta and no ancestor depth, and repairs only the statistically demonstrable tail where text geometry and behaviour contrast disagree, with level-1 and per-level prefix drift measured and bounded.
NOVELTY: Unlike round 1 (curved residual chain), round 2 (global popularity-adjusted successor barycentre), round 3 (extra PPMI-direction level pinned by argmin), poincare-frechet-successor-codebook (successor-weighted Frechet codebook), CURVCTRL-SID (level curvature from prefix-transition score) and BRad-RQ (behaviour-ranked radial assignment), this never re-ranks or moves the bulk. It audits at most 5% of 24556 items; the eligible set is fixed by a degree-stratified permutation null on behaviour contrast; the target codeword is chosen inside one Lorentzian score containing both behaviour affinity and curved distance; the budget is emergent from the null; the guard is measured; curvature is a gauge fixed by a data quantile, so there is nothing to tune.
CHANGE: At the end of frozen Stage 2, build train-only successor-PPMI profiles, select items whose contrast with their level-1 subtree is significant under a degree-conserving permutation null, and re-quantize only those items (<=5% of 24556) with one score: z-scored behaviour affinity to the candidate subtree profile minus z-scored Lorentz distance to the candidate cumulative reconstruction, under a checked and reported prefix guard.
SPECIFICATION: N=24556, L=4, K codebook size per level; h_i frozen Stage-2 encoder output; e(l,k) level-l codebook vector; c(i,l) baseline codeword; r(i,l)=sum_{m<=l} e(m,c(i,m)). From TRAIN sequences only: successor counts N_ij, top-50 PPMI vectors b_i (L2), subtree profiles beta(l,k)=L2(mean_{j:prefix_l(j)=k} b_j). Eligibility g_i=max_{k!=c(i,1)} cos(b_i,beta(1,k))-cos(b_i,beta(1,c(i,1))); null = 20 permutations of b inside outgoing-degree deciles; tau = 99.5th percentile of pooled null g (documented 0.5% false-positive convention); eligible iff g_i>tau and total behavioural degree d_i>=20. Rank by d_i*g_i descending, B_max=floor(0.05N). Curvature gauge c0=1/q99({||h_i||} U {||e(l,k)||})^2. Map x~=exp_0^{c0}(x). Score s(i,l,k)=zhat_k[cos(b_i,beta(l,k))]-zhat_k[d_{c0}(x~(h_i),x~(r(i,l-1)+e(l,k)))/R_l], R_l = median baseline d_{c0}(x~(h_i),x~(r(i,l))) floored at 1e-3, zhat per-item z-score over k with sigma floor 1e-6. For a selected item greedy l=1..L: k*=argmax_{k used} s(i,l,k); flip only if s(i,l,k*)>s(i,l,c(i,l)); else keep baseline codeword and residual. Guard: level-1 count total variation <=0.05; distinct used prefix counts each level within +/-5% of baseline; changed level-1 tokens <=0.05N. On failure drop the lowest d_i*g_i item and recompute (<=B_max times). Export repaired SID table to the frozen Stage-3 protocol.
COST: Per training step at the frozen scale: 0 added work; 24 steps/epoch x 3000 epochs unchanged at 0.145-0.16 s/epoch (435-480 s). Audit once at expor

ANSWER HCAUDIT-SID part 2/3:
t: 4*N*K <= 1.0e8 score evaluations after 24556+4K exp maps and 4K subtree profiles, about 1-10 GPU-seconds (1-2 CPU-minutes), under 0.2% of Stage-2 wall clock; guard bisection <=1227 histogram recomputations; Stage 3 unchanged. Total added wall clock under 1 minute.
HYPOTHESIS: Worth keeping iff (i) mean behaviour contrast between an item and its prefix-siblings falls on the audited tail (train-only), (ii) Euclidean-versus-hyperbolic target disagreement is non-trivial so geometry is not a gauge artifact, and (iii) one frozen Stage-3 run reaches test_recall@10 > 0.065 (realistically above the untouched 0.0679). If only 1-2% repair and recall is flat within seed noise, the idea fails and is recorded negative with its number.
RISKS: The eligible tail may be too small to move Stage 3; the null may reject almost everything; flips may land on low-degree items Stage 3 rarely sees; the level-1 guard may force B to zero; behaviour affinity may be dominated by a few large subtrees; hyperbolic and Euclidean rankings may agree almost everywhere, leaving geometry decorative. Each is measured and reported.
BEHAVIOR SIGNAL: Directed item transitions from the Stage-2 TRAIN split only, compressed into row-stochastic successor profiles and top-50 PPMI vectors, plus each item's total behavioural degree.
BEHAVIOR COMPUTATION: Walk each Stage-2 training user sequence, count consecutive directed pairs (i->j) into N_ij; row-normalize to S_i; keep the 50 successors with the largest positive PMI; b_ij=max(0, log(N_ij*sumN/(row_i*col_j))); L2-normalize b_i; out-degree and in-degree are train row and column sums. Validation and test sequences are never opened and no Stage-3 interaction is used.
LEAKAGE BOUNDARY: Transition counts, PPMI profiles, the permutation null, curvature quantile c0, scales R_l and guard thresholds all come from Stage-2 train items and train embeddings only. No validation or test item contributes a transition, embedding, percentile or threshold. The repaired table is produced before Stage 3 starts and is not revisited after any Stage-3 signal exists.
HYPERBOLIC OPERATOR: Hyperboloid (Lorentz) model of curvature -c0, c0=1/q99(||.||)^2: <x,y>_L=-x_0 y_0+x_s.y_s; exp_0(v)=((1/sqrt(c0))cosh(sqrt(c0)||v||),(1/sqrt(c0))sinh(sqrt(c0)||v||)v/||v||); d_{c0}(x,y)=(1/sqrt(c0))arcosh(-c0<x,y>_L). c0 is explicitly a gauge: scaling every tangent by 1/sqrt(c0) and using curvature 1 reproduces the ordering, so c0 is fixed only for numerical range and never tuned; all non-gauge content is the non-linearity of exp_0 and d_{c0}.
HYPERBOLIC LOCATION: In quantization, at the Stage-2-to-Stage-3 SID export (curved re-quantization of an otherwise frozen Euclidean RQ-VAE); it is not a term added to the Euclidean encoder loss.
COUPLING PATH: One pathway: train transitions -> PPMI b_i -> subtree profile beta(l,k) -> eligibility g_i with permutation null -> the SAME score s(i,l,k) containing the Lorentz distance -> selected codeword -> repaired SID token -> Stage 3. Behaviour off zeroes every g_i so no item is eligible and tokens equal baseline. Geometry off replaces d_{c0} by Euclidean distance, changing the selected codeword while eligibility is intact. There is no separate behaviour loss and no separate hyperbolic loss: one score, one argmax, one token.
COUPLING EQUATION: s(i,l,k)=zhat_k[cos(b_i,beta(l,k))]-zhat_k[d_{c0}(exp_0(h_i),exp_0(r(i,l-1)+e(l,k)))/R_l], with g_i=max_k cos(b_i,beta(1,k))-cos(b_i,beta(1,c(i,1)))>tau_null and d_i>=20; behaviour term is the first bracket, curved term the Lorentz distance in the second, and a flip requires s(i,l,k*)>s(i,l,c(i

ANSWER HCAUDIT-SID part 3/3:
,l)).
OBSERVABLES: The exported SID table (how many items changed and at which level); B_final and guard values (level-1 total variation, per-level distinct-prefix ratio, changed level-1 token count); Euclidean-versus-hyperbolic target disagreement on the eligible set; behaviour-contrast coherence of each item with its prefix-siblings before and after (train-only); successor-predictability of exported prefixes; and the frozen Stage-3 test_recall@10.
ABLATION BEHAVIOR OFF: use_behaviour=False. beta(l,k) replaced by a constant vector, every g_i=0, tau selects nobody; the exported table is identical to the baseline Stage-2 table (tested for exact identity) and the pipeline is untouched TIGER_BEHDIR-L4. Wired and tested, never trained.
ABLATION GEOMETRY OFF: use_hyperbolic=False. Eligibility, null, budget and guard unchanged; d_{c0}(exp_0(.),exp_0(.))/R_l replaced by ||h_i-(r(i,l-1)+e(l,k))||/R_l^E with the corresponding Euclidean median. Selected codewords and repaired tokens change; eligibility does not. Wired, disagreement reported, never trained.
ABLATION BOTH ON: use_behaviour=True and use_hyperbolic=True. The single run of the round: frozen Stage 2 (3000 epochs, four-GPU DDP, global batch 4096), audit at export, frozen Stage-3 protocol (150 epochs, seed 42, beam 20), judged by test_recall@10.
SPEC EQUATIONS: c0=1/q99({||h_i||} U {||e(l,k)||})^2; exp_0(v)=(cosh(sqrt(c0)||v||)/sqrt(c0), sinh(sqrt(c0)||v||)v/(sqrt(c0)||v||)) for v!=0 and (1/sqrt(c0),0) for v=0; d_{c0}(x,y)=arcosh(clamp(-c0<x,y>_L,1+1e-7))/sqrt(c0); b_i=L2([max(0,log(N_ij*sumN/(row_i*col_j)))]) over top50(i); beta(l,k)=L2(mean_{j:prefix_l(j)=k} b_j) with global-mean fallback; g_i as above; tau=percentile_99.5({g_i^(r)}) over 20 degree-preserving permutations; R_l=max(median_i d_{c0}(exp_0(h_i),exp_0(r(i,l))),1e-3); s(i,l,k)=(A-mean_k A)/max(sd_k A,1e-6)-(D-mean_k D)/max(sd_k D,1e-6) with A=cos(b_i,beta(l,k)) and D=d_{c0}(exp_0(h_i),exp_0(r(i,l-1)+e(l,k)))/R_l; E={i:g_i>tau and d_i>=20}; sort by d_i*g_i desc; for B from B_max=floor(0.05N) down: q=h_i, for l=1..L: k*=argmax_{k used}s(i,l,k), k_l=k* if s(i,l,k*)>s(i,l,c(i,l)) else c(i,l), q=q-e(l,k_l); SID'=(k_1..k_L); accept if TV(level1)<=0.05 and every |distinct(prefix_l)|/|distinct_baseline(prefix_l)| in [0.95,1.05] and #{k_1!=c(i,1)}<=0.05N, else drop lowest d_i*g_i and repeat.
SPEC INPUTS OUTPUTS: Inputs: frozen Stage-2 encoder outputs h_i (N x d), four codebooks e(l,k), baseline SID table c(i,l), Stage-2 TRAIN transition counts N_ij with row/column sums. Outputs: repaired SID' (N x 4) for the frozen Stage-3 protocol plus an audit report (B_final, guard values, disagreement rate, contrast coherence before/after, eligible count before the cap).
SAFEGUARDS: (1) arcosh argument clamped >=1+1e-7 and exp-map inputs clipped to ||v||<=q99.9(||.||) so cosh stays near 3 and no point nears the ball boundary; (2) v=0 uses the series limit; (3) R_l floored at 1e-3 and z-score sigma floored at 1e-6; (4) empty subtree profiles use the global mean PPMI vector; (5) items with total behavioural degree <20 are never eligible (removes one-transition noise); (6) if fewer than 30 items pass the null the audit is a no-op, B_final=0 is reported and the baseline table is exported; (7) no objective has the ball origin as its minimum, encoder and codebooks are frozen, and at least 95% of items keep every token, so the round-one origin collapse cannot occur; (8) the guard bisection is monotone and terminates at B=0, and final guard values are reported rather than asserted.
END IDEA
